tier: T1 (T1-kin: a self-action OPEN loop; ego state = own executed motion; cameras logged) -- never 'closed loop'. The lead's logged future does not react to the ego: a track that closes on the lead is scored against where the lead WAS. That is the instrument's contract and it is stated with every number.
estimator: taniteval.ci.paired_episode_cluster_bootstrap, B=2000, seed 0, resampling EPISODES on the windows where both sides are finite. It answers ONLY 'would another draw of EPISODES say this?' -- blind to training-run variance (H-ESTIM-SEED-1); the seed floor F=|mean_s0-mean_s1| of the arm rides beside every delta and no outcome reads it.
